source.snippet: I'm contemplating moving out of the US for personal reasons (to a place I am also a citizen) and would like to hear the stories of US citizens who live outside the US. The tax implications and reporting requirements seem daunting. In particular I plan to pursue primarily self-employment/entrepreneurship which gets hit by the GILTI tax. And increased reporting requirements with huge penalties.

problem_statement: US citizen entrepreneurs and self-employed professionals relocating abroad face an extremely complex web of tax obligations — GILTI, FBAR, foreign tax credits, self-employment tax — with severe penalties for errors, but no affordable specialized tooling or advisory service exists that covers this specific combination.
target_segment: US citizen freelancers, founders, and self-employed professionals who are relocating or have relocated abroad and need ongoing compliance guidance for US extraterritorial tax obligations.
notes: Poster is explicitly an entrepreneur/self-employed person, mentions GILTI by name — showing sophistication and real research done. The penalty risk (mentioned explicitly) creates strong willingness-to-pay for a reliable solution. Recurring problem: US expat tax software market exists (TaxAct, Greenback, Bright!Tax) but none specialize in the self-employed/founder GILTI+FBAR combination. Fresh signal (2026-09-15), 4 comments. Buyer: solo operator or founder willing to pay for peace of mind on compliance.
